b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line downloader.

`tinydl` fetches a URL over HTTP and writes the result either to a file or to
standard output. Failed requests are retried automatically (see
`app/config.py`).

## Usage

```
python -m app.cli URL [options]
```

## Command line options

The following options are accepted by the command line interface.

| Option | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Example

```
python -m app.cli https://example.com/file.bin -o file.bin
```
'
